_readme: Manual crest verification queue. Keyed by club id (data.js `id`). Fields: img (optional: path under crests/ that must win over any scraper output), verified (1 = a human compared the badge with the club's official source), src (where it was checked), date (YYYY-MM-DD). scripts/apply_crest_overrides.py stamps `ck:1` (and img) into js/data.js; the club page shows a green check on ck. Remove an entry (or set verified 0) to pull the check. Never set verified on a crest nobody has eyeballed.
